Statement excerpt, proposition, conditions, axis and outcome are otherwise correct.

The statement excerpt is verbatim. The proposition's broader 'no form' fits the 'either' context and the contract's interpretation, and 'or' matches the contradiction condition. The rationale correctly says the METR (July testing) and V-JEPA 2 (June) limitations cover selected systems from earlier periods. It also says the absence of a counterexample cannot establish the universal claim. Citations, dates and context relations match the frozen items. Unresolved matches the agreed reviews.

The e1 public excerpt 'better returns on the margin.' cuts the frozen sentence 'First, OpenAI decided to prioritize scaling post-training, which had better returns on the margin.' It drops what had better returns, namely post-training. Read alone, the fragment could suggest scaling in general had better marginal returns. That is close to the opposite of the point being made. The rationale, limitations and unresolved outcome are otherwise supported, and the CNBC citation is correct.
